claims.hypothesis: Higher density and turbulence promote core fragmentation

claims.result: Multiples have higher mass, density, Mach number, R/R_Jeans, M/M_Jeans

evidence.quote: The dense cores forming binary or multiple systems tend to exhibit higher density, Mach numbers, ratios of core radii to Jeans radii, and ratios of core mass to Jeans mass

claims.finding: Magnetic field has limited influence on fragmentation

evidence.quote: The magnetic field does not influence the morphology and orientation of the dense cores and the occurrence of fragmentation.

limitations_admitted.value: Protostellar mass not included in core mass, so gravity may be underestimated
